title: Average review rating
statementMd:
What is the average review rating across all reviews, rounded to 2 decimals?

Expected columns: `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
